evidence.title: OpenRig README
evidence.locator: README.md What It Does, Teams, How It Works, Key Concepts, Requirements, Comparison
evidence.finding: Open-source multi-agent harness on tmux: RigSpec YAML teams, rig up/down snapshots, rig send/broadcast/chatroom, TUI, MCP server, Claude Code/Codex/Pi runtimes, Slack (experimental), requires Node 22/24, tmux, macOS or Linux (WSL2 on Windows), Apache-2.0 badge; self-hosted with provider costs separate.

evidence.title: Apache-2.0 license
evidence.finding: Apache License 2.0 text at repository root.

evidence.title: Root package metadata
evidence.finding: Monorepo with packages cli, daemon, tui, ui, test-system; Node engines 22 or 24.

evidence.title: rig CLI reference (as-built)
evidence.locator: queue, watchdog, workflow, policy, usage, telemetry, host, gateway, seat sections
evidence.finding: Generated reference of rig commands: queue (create, claim, block, handoff, resolve, transitions), watchdog register/update/stop, workflow compile/instantiate/trace, policy permissions, usage cost/top/series, host add/pair (ssh/http), gateway, seat, send, chatroom, snapshot/restore.

evidence.title: Queue command implementation
evidence.finding: rig queue create/claim/unclaim/update/block/resolve/handoff/show/list/overdue with states and closure reasons backed by the daemon database.

evidence.title: Watchdog command implementation
evidence.finding: rig watchdog register/list/show/status/stop/update schedule interval jobs against a target session with a policy.

evidence.title: Queue wake ladder
evidence.finding: Daemon escalation ladder that wakes owners of queue rows (wake-after timers, undelivered and overdue handling).

evidence.title: MCP server
evidence.finding: rig mcp serve exposes tools (rig_up, rig_ps, rig_send, rig_queue_*, rig_chatroom_send, rig_telemetry_events) over stdio or HTTP with bearer tokens issued per seat.

evidence.title: Usage command
evidence.finding: rig usage top/cost/series report per-seat usage and cost from harness transcripts.

evidence.title: Workflow daemon routes
evidence.finding: Daemon routes for workflow compile, instantiate, project, trace and continue with blocked/depends handling.

evidence.title: RigSpec reference
evidence.locator: Team launch defaults; Codex sandbox and approval selection
evidence.finding: RigSpec pods, members, edges and continuity; per-member runtime, model, permission policy; Codex members can record sandbox workspace-write/read-only and approval flags; team launch default permissions.

evidence.title: Quickstart
evidence.finding: Install, talk to the kernel operator, choose starter, workshop or factory team.

evidence.title: Getting started
evidence.finding: Installation steps and prerequisites including WSL2 reported working setup.

evidence.title: Community harness presets
evidence.finding: Community-maintained harness presets (examples for Cursor, Hermes, OpenClaw, omo, pi-tui, dsh, openshell) launched by typing a command into a pane; untested by OpenRig and shown as community.

evidence.title: ACP agents
evidence.locator: rig acp run and permission requests
evidence.finding: rig acp run hands one queue row to an ACP-speaking agent; permission requests become queue rows answered by an owner; outcome, tokens and cost recorded.

evidence.title: Hosted members
evidence.locator: Set one up; How it works its rows
evidence.finding: Tools outside the terminal (assistants, bots, cloud routines) join as members through the MCP server under revocable per-seat tokens; experimental, off by default, user-provided TLS.

evidence.title: Browser access
evidence.locator: What works with no setup; web UI
evidence.finding: Web UI turned on with rig config set ui.enabled true; daemon accepts localhost, IPs and Tailscale names; allowed hosts and origins configurable.

evidence.title: Keeping a watch
evidence.finding: A watch is an operator-owned queue task with a one-shot wake timer re-armed by the operator; reports to a registered human channel (Slack, TUI Feed); status 0.7.0 with native run not yet performed.

evidence.title: Host load and transcript capture
evidence.finding: Host CPU count, load averages, running seats and transcript capture counters; observations not billing.

evidence.title: Non-interruptive mode
evidence.finding: Opt-in mode accepting supported harness first-launch warnings for full_bypass seats; does not change permission policy.

evidence.title: Gateway participants
evidence.finding: Several people and shared channels registered with organizations, groups and policy text that agents read; OpenRig does not enforce the policy.

evidence.title: Seat delivery
evidence.finding: Row state says who claimed or finished work; permission stop observation per actor; delivery refused when a pane is at a shell.

evidence.title: Finite telemetry metadata
evidence.finding: Local read of retained events, queue transitions and tenures from the daemon via CLI, HTTP and MCP; not an outbound telemetry feed.

evidence.title: Knowledge maturity ladder
evidence.locator: The ladder; promotion and demotion; warrant rule
evidence.finding: Claims are tied to visible maturity stages with promotion and demotion rules and a warrant rule requiring durable evidence.

evidence.title: Lore routing
evidence.finding: Knowledge earned by a seat is kept as Markdown under that seat lore directory with a stable address and a composition grant for leaving the position boundary.

evidence.title: rig usage command
evidence.locator: packages/cli/src/commands/usage.ts lines 1-6 and 40-75 (CostPayload, Pi cost line, providerChargeText)
evidence.finding: rig usage serves tokens per hour, window velocities and an explicit unknown rail from the daemon usage routes; rig usage cost prints Pi seats a model-priced estimate from persisted entries with what is excluded named, shows OpenRouter charge beside (never summed with) the estimate, prints tiny amounts as <$0.01 not $0.00, and says not reported when absent.

evidence.title: Usage series projection
evidence.locator: packages/daemon/src/domain/usage-series.ts lines 1-24 (lanes context and provider_window, honesty rails)
evidence.finding: Over-time usage query over usage_samples with lanes context and provider_window (provider usage-window percentages), counted resets, no negative burn, and an explicit unknown entry with reason instead of a fabricated zero; no account field is served.

evidence.title: Watchdog scheduler
evidence.finding: One in-flight tick at a time; a slow tick delays the next and overlapping ticks are not queued; stop awaits the in-flight tick.

evidence.title: Watchdog policy engine
evidence.finding: Built-in watchdog policies: artifact-pool-ready, edge-artifact-required, periodic-reminder and context-usage-threshold.

evidence.title: Web UI shell
evidence.finding: Web UI layout code has a mobile rail that collapses into a top-bar menu, iOS-minimum tap targets (line 291) and a phone-first single-column slice review; a viewport hook switches layouts at an iPad-portrait breakpoint.

evidence.title: Workflow acceptance options
evidence.finding: rig workflow project accepts a typed acceptance candidate identity, verdict and evidence reference together.

evidence.title: Bounded search of the pinned release
evidence.locator: rg over packages (excluding node_modules and tests), docs and README at v0.7.16
evidence.finding: No tracker integration: rg -i for linear.app, jira and asana in packages found only CSS linear gradients and timing; no SSO code beyond provider OAuth handling; git worktree appears only in operator guidance text (specs/rigs/launch/kernel/agents/operator/agent/guidance/role.md:262, assets/skills/rigs/SKILL.md:33), not as a provisioning command; no sandbox-exec, bwrap or firejail; docker is used only for service-backed rigs; packages/cli/src/commands/send.ts has no image or attachment option (rg image|attach finds only the rig attach help text at lines 290-291).

evidence.title: Roadmap
evidence.finding: Help-wanted list with no schedule.

evidence.title: As-built architecture
evidence.finding: Local daemon (Hono HTTP) over SQLite, tmux and runtime adapters; CLI, TUI and MCP clients.

evidence.title: TUI package
evidence.finding: Terminal UI topology graph/table, seats, specs, projects, feed and system views.

evidence.title: React web UI package
evidence.finding: Older React web UI served by the daemon when ui.enabled is set; maintenance mode.

evidence.title: OpenRig v0.7.16 release
evidence.finding: Latest stable release at pass time.

evidence.title: GitHub repository metadata
evidence.finding: 8,870 stars on 2026-11-16; Apache-2.0; not archived; pushed 2026-11-16.

evidence.locator: See it running; Terminal UI and Workspaces
evidence.finding: Real TUI recording and a TUI topology screenshot captured from the interactive demo with fictional project data.
